segments.normalizedSource: ```objc CFOptionFlags sockopt = CFSocketGetSocketFlags (mysock ); /* Set the read callback to be automatically reenabled. */ sockopt |= kCFSocketAutomaticallyReenableReadCallBack; /* Clear the close-on-invalidate flag. */ sockopt &= ~kCFSocketCloseOnInvalidate; CFSocketSetSocketFlags(s, sockopt); ```
